summary: The SiteRequirements component is part of the HSPnet application, responsible for managing requirements related to site disciplines. It includes user interface elements such as dropdowns, labels, and buttons, integrates with user sessions, and handles discipline subdisciplines, data management for requirements, and prerequisite options.
purpose: To manage and display site-related requirements, including handling prerequisites, subdiscipline filters, and allowing user interaction through a web-based user interface.

workflows.name: Modify Requirements
steps: Select discipline filter according to user input.
Update or add requirements based on user interaction.
Save changes to the database and update user session.

business_rules: Users must be authenticated to access site requirements.
All disciplines must be loaded on the first page load.
Restricted subdisciplines must be hidden from unauthorized users.
validations: Check if UserSession is null before performing operations.
Validate prerequisite options during selection or update.
calculations: Calculate section headers to be consistent with group sections in the GridView.
conditions: If UseSubDisciplines is true, make subdisciplines visible.
If RestrictedSubDisciplines is true and no subdiscipline ID is found, display a note indicating allowed disciplines.
system_behavior: UI dynamically updates based on user interactions such as adding or removing disciplines.
AJAX is used to handle asynchronous updates in the user interface.
exceptions: Operation cancellation when UserSession is null.
